environment.description: Same application deployed on identical EC2 instance behind ALB. AWS WAF WebACL attached to ALB with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT (permissive), and (2) a custom rule group 'prod-sqli-orderby-guard' with priority 1 containing a regex match rule on query string parameter 'sort' — the rule uses a RegexPatternSet that matches any value containing characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9_] (pattern: [^a-zA-Z0-9_]) with action BLOCK. Additionally, a second custom rule matches the 'sort' parameter value against a string list constraint (exact match, case-insensitive) for values: 'name', 'price', 'category', 'sku', 'id' — requests with sort values not in this list receive BLOCK. Both custom rules must match (OR logic — either triggers block) for the request to be blocked.
